projects.title: Data Grouping with Object.groupBy & Map.groupBy (ES2024)
projects.description: Group a large dataset of student enrollments by course subject and pass/fail status using the modern ES2024 Object.groupBy() and Map.groupBy() methods.
projects.exampleOutput: Grouped by course: { JS: [{ name: 'Swadeep' }, { name: 'Tuhina' }], Python: [{ name: 'Debangshu' }] }
projects.learningOutcome: Mastering native ES2024 Object.groupBy() and Map.groupBy() for zero-dependency data partitioning.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **ES2024 GroupBy Standardization (§20.1.3)**:
Previously, grouping arrays required writing custom `reduce()` accumulators or installing Lodash (`_.groupBy`). `Object.groupBy(iterable, callback)` returns a null-prototype object with array buckets.
2. **`Map.groupBy` Advantage**:
Allows using complex object or symbol keys as dictionary lookup buckets.
projects.codeExplanation: The script runs student datasets through `Object.groupBy()` and `Map.groupBy()`, demonstrating multi-level categorization.
